title: BPM Cables (Semi Rigid) for ALS-U
agency: ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.ENERGY, DEPARTMENT OF.BERKELEY NATL LAB - DOE CONTRACTOR
description_text: Dear Prospective Offeror, The University of California, on behalf of the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory (LBNL), would like to invite you to participate in Request for Proposal (RFP) No. AA-2026-0​4 for ​ALS-U ​B​eam Position Monitor (BPM) Semi Rigid Cables. The RFP and associated documents (listed below) are attached hereto: 0. RFP and Proposal Preparation Instructions 1. Statement of Work (SOW) 2. Acceptance Criteria List (ACL) 3. Sample Subcontract 4. Rep Cert Form (required with submission) 5. Price Proposal​ Schedule, Attachment A (required with submission) 6. Past Performance Reference Information Form (required with submission) 7. ALS-U Quality Evaluation Survey (required with submission) Timeline of Events: RFP Release - ​April 13, 2026 Questions for Clarification - no later than​ April 17, 2026 Submissions due - no later than ​A​pril 27, 2026
